subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: The cross-document arm shall report a defect when any document carries an in-scope `delivery:` citation (per FR-9) whose anchor resolves into the delivery ledger's derived-state region rather than a journal `E-n` entry.
rationale: the derived-state block is never citable / never authoritative (DINV-6); a cross-document citation is invisible to any single-file check
fit_criterion: on the cited-derived-block fixture, the cross-document arm reports a defect identifying the citing document and the derived-region target; it is red at the cross-document arm only
